Single mosaic file (s_) · 960×600 · 3 min clips · ≈%1$s/min · lighter load

Clips are not deleted by date. Each clip is saved with a sequence number (_id_1, _id_2, …); a new clip always continues from the last clip\'s number, or starts at _id_1 if there are none. When free space nears the 2 GB reserve, the size of the next clip is taken into account and clips are deleted starting from the lowest number (oldest) until enough space is freed; deletion stops once there is room. ≈ %1$s of recording fits.
USB auto-recording is on. Turn it off in USB Recording first.

When the ignition is on (power mode 2), the cameras are recorded to %1$s in the selected mode as 3-minute clips.

• Clips are saved with date/time and a sequence number (_id_N); there is no deletion by date.
• When free space nears the 2 GB reserve, the lowest-numbered (oldest) clip is deleted; deletion stops once there is room.
• At least 2 GB is always left free on the device.
• USB recording can't be used while this mode is on.
